# Subway Seat for Sass

A $ss-* variable for every role and a $subway-seat map of the same. The names match across flavors, so switching is a one-word change to the @use.

[Sass](https://sass-lang.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/scss/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`_subway-seat.scss`](_subway-seat.scss) | your Sass load path, e.g. styles/_subway-seat.scss |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`_subway-seat-tunnel.scss`](_subway-seat-tunnel.scss) | your Sass load path, e.g. styles/_subway-seat-tunnel.scss |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`_subway-seat-enamel.scss`](_subway-seat-enamel.scss) | your Sass load path, e.g. styles/_subway-seat-enamel.scss |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in any stylesheet, with the partial on your load path:

```scss
@use "sass:map";
@use "subway-seat" as *;

body {
  background: $ss-base;
  color: map.get($subway-seat, "text");
}
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in any stylesheet, with the partial on your load path:

```scss
@use "sass:map";
@use "subway-seat-tunnel" as *;

body {
  background: $ss-base;
  color: map.get($subway-seat, "text");
}
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in any stylesheet, with the partial on your load path:

```scss
@use "sass:map";
@use "subway-seat-enamel" as *;

body {
  background: $ss-base;
  color: map.get($subway-seat, "text");
}
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
